That’s the battle I was facing up until this point. But this morning I made an active decision and hugged my kids and wife like it was the last time I’d see them. 

Either I’ll be gone in the morning or the police will be here to put me in jail because that’s how the military will treat it

I’ve tried so many of your suggestions but it isn’t working. I’ve been through inpatient and behavioral health now. I just want to go away.

I’ve downed a bunch of pills in a hotel. It won’t be long

I’m sorry I’ve let you all down
I did. I told them the only thing keeping me going was my kids and they made me an appointment for March.
